title: Asari’s self-improving agents optimise the full LLM serving stack
friendlyTitle: AI agents improved the software that runs large AI models
summary: Asari reports that parallel optimisation agents improved throughput and interactivity by up to 16% for DeepSeek v4 Pro and GLM 5.2 on NVIDIA B200 systems running vLLM. The agents changed kernels, schedulers, load balancers and configuration, then used distribution-level checks to test whether model behaviour remained consistent.
friendlySummary: Asari’s agents tested many changes across an AI serving system and reported speed gains of up to 16%. They also checked that the model’s output behaviour stayed similar.
whyItMatters: This is a concrete example of agents improving production infrastructure rather than only writing application code. The important pattern is the closed loop: profile, change, benchmark, verify and save lessons for later runs instead of accepting an unverified speed claim.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Agents may help engineers find useful speed improvements across very complex systems. Careful tests are needed so faster does not mean wrong.
